# Novus Freight Inc.

> Your Gateway to Global Market. Expert international freight forwarding, customs clearance, and worldwide delivery services for businesses of all sizes.

Freight forwarder, NVOCC and customs broker based in Binondo, Manila, Philippines. Founded in 2017 by two Licensed Customs Brokers. Website: https://nfiph.com

## Services
- Non-Vessel Operating Common Carrier (NVOCC): Novus operates as an NVOCC for full container loads (FCL) and LCL consolidation cargo.
  - FCL
  - LCL (consolidation cargo)
- International Freight Forwarding: Import and export by sea and air, triangular shipments between foreign countries, and processing and releasing.
  - Import & Export (Sea and Air)
  - Import & Export by air
  - Triangular Shipments (foreign countries to other foreign countries)
  - Processing and Releasing
- Domestic / Local Freight Forwarding: Domestic and local freight forwarding across the Philippines by sea, land and air.
  - Sea
  - Land
  - Air
- Customs Clearances: Import and export customs clearance under CIF, CFR, DDP and DDU, for general, perishable, PEZA, breakbulk and project cargoes.
  - Import & Export
  - CIF, CFR, DDP, DDU
  - General Cargoes
  - Perishable Cargoes
  - PEZA Cargoes
  - Breakbulk Cargoes
  - Project Cargoes
- Trucking Services: Trailer trucks, small trucks, and winged van and closed van trucking.
  - Trailer Trucks
  - Small Trucks
  - Winged Van & Closed Van

## Company history
- 2017: Started as JBC Customs Brokerage, founded by two Licensed Customs Brokers and registered with the DTI. Focused on customs brokerage.
- Sept 2020: Rebranded as Novus Cargo Logistics Inc.
- July 2021: Became Novus Freight Inc., registered with the SEC.
- COVID-19 years: Expanded into a One-Stop Shop Logistics provider: international and domestic freight forwarding, customs brokerage and trucking. Grew stronger through the pandemic.

## About
Novus-Freight Inc. is a reliable partner in the logistics industry, providing administrative support for freight forwarding, customs brokerage, and other markets. The company’s services ensure a seamless and efficient flow of goods across borders. Novus-Freight Inc. is committed to excellence, tailoring services to meet clients’ specific needs, and delivering innovative solutions with a team of seasoned professionals.

Mission: To provide customer satisfaction by delivering quality services in a cost-effective and reliable solution resulting in a long-term partnership with our client.

Vision: The organization envisions one of the most reliable and valued logistics providers. We strived to provide our clients with the best QUALITY and EFFICIENT service possible with the continual development at hand.

Values: Accountability, Integrity, Quality, Innovation

## FAQ
- Q: When did Novus Freight start?
  A: Novus began in 2017 as JBC Customs Brokerage, founded by two Licensed Customs Brokers and registered with the DTI. It rebranded in September 2020 as Novus Cargo Logistics Inc. and became Novus Freight Inc. in July 2021, registered with the SEC.
- Q: Is Novus licensed and accredited?
  A: Yes. Novus lists these local licenses and accreditations: PEZA, Department of Finance, PMTLAI, Civil Aeronautics Board, DOLE, DTI and the National Privacy Commission. Novus Freight Inc. is registered with the SEC.
- Q: Which international networks is Novus part of?
  A: Novus is connected to the WCA World, JC Trans and All World Shipping networks, which link it to logistics partners worldwide.
- Q: What is Novus’s mission?
  A: To provide customer satisfaction by delivering quality services in a cost-effective and reliable solution resulting in a long-term partnership with our client.
- Q: What is Novus’s vision?
  A: The organization envisions one of the most reliable and valued logistics providers, providing clients with the best quality and efficient service possible, with continual development.
- Q: What are Novus’s values?
  A: Accountability, Integrity, Quality and Innovation. Novus takes full responsibility for its work, acts ethically, holds itself to high standards and keeps improving to meet clients’ most demanding needs.
- Q: Which trade terms does Novus handle?
  A: Novus’s customs clearance covers shipments under CIF, CFR, DDP and DDU.
- Q: How many countries does Novus serve?
  A: Novus’s website lists 50+ countries, served through its international networks (WCA World, JC Trans and All World Shipping). For a specific port or route, the team confirms the routing.
- Q: Is support available 24/7?
  A: Novus’s website lists 24/7 support. You can also reach the team at (+63) 02 8637-7930 or inquirynovus@nfiph.com.
- Q: How do I get a quote?
  A: Send your shipment details through the quote form or email inquirynovus@nfiph.com. Novus replies with the actual rate for your shipment.
